description: Import markets for a product ranked by size, with 3-year growth, Korea's share and the reply rate Korean exporters of that industry actually got there (reply_scope: industry = compared with the industry's average; none = no emails from that industry yet, so not ranked). 'pick' marks the Pareto frontier: no other market is both bigger and replies better. Korea (domestic) and sanctioned markets are excluded from picks; regional_hub flags re-export hubs whose imports overstate local demand.

item.description: Product as an HS4 code (e.g. '3304') or a name in English or Korean (e.g. 'sunscreen', '라면'). Names cover TradeGraph's 35 items; any other product works as a 4-digit HS code (e.g. '1905' biscuits, '2005' kimchi, '3305' shampoo) with live UN Comtrade imports.
